web.description:
# Afreximbank arm buys into D'banj's CREAM to monetise African creative IP
CANEX Creations, a subsidiary of the [African Export-Import Bank](https://app.dealroom.co/investors/african_export_import_bank), has acquired an equity stake in [CREAM](https://app.dealroom.co/companies/creamplatform), the creator platform led by Afrobeats star Dapo Oyebanjo, known as D'banj. The parties did not disclose the size of the stake or the value of the investment.

CREAM — Creative, Reality, Entertainment, Arts and Music — launched in 2016 with [MTN Nigeria](https://app.dealroom.co/companies/mtn_nigeria) and the [Bank of Industry](https://app.dealroom.co/companies/boi_1), and says it has signed up more than seven million subscribers through its USSD code, website, and app.

The deal reflects a shift in the bank's support for the sector from debt and grants toward equity in platforms that can monetise content at scale.
